decisions.change: Prioritize the printer-free shoes-only return, keep the jacket non-editable, and leave starting and exact approval to the trusted host.

Use both observed draft routes. Explain that QR drop-off fits the printer-free goal but changed the destination to store credit; retain original-payment intent and provide explicit restoration and validation.
Render fees and refund amounts only from current task data, distinguish selected choices from observed source values, and expose unknown terms.

Explicitly handle submitted_unverified, lock further choice changes, offer a read-only check when permitted, and distinguish matching draft checks from saved confirmation. During submission, explain host inspection or recovery without enabling forbidden actions or inferring success from waiting.

Generate informational route cards from discovery screens and flows, show actual reached-state labels, and disclose incomplete exploration rather than claiming every named route reached its intended screen.
Use cream and forest colors, readable typography, visible native-control labels, keyboard focus indicators, a live status region, and a narrow-screen single-column layout.
